claims.text: HF: not used alone (except for HTN), but a thiazide can be added to a loop for more diuresis and a lower loop dose;
claims.quote: Thiazide diuretics are not normally used alone unless being given as treatment of hypertension; however, a thiazide diuretic may be added to a loop diuretic for additional diuresis and to reduce the loop diuretic dose.

claims.text: HCTZ, metolazone and chlorthalidone are used this way.
claims.quote: Hydrochlorothiazide, metolazone, and chlorthalidone can be used in this manner.

claims.text: Edema doses: metolazone 5–20 mg once daily (cardiac failure);
claims.quote: Metolazone tablets, USP, 5 to 20 mg once daily.
claims.locator: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION (Edema of cardiac failure)

claims.text: chlorthalidone 50–100 mg daily or 100 mg on alternate days,
claims.quote: Initiation: Adults, initially 50 to 100 mg daily, or 100 mg on alternate days.

claims.text: taken in the morning with food.
claims.quote: A single dose given in the morning with food is recommended

claims.text: Metolazone + furosemide (or other loops): unusually large or prolonged fluid and electrolyte losses;
claims.quote: Furosemide and probably other loop diuretics given concomitantly with metolazone can cause unusually large or prolonged losses of fluid and electrolytes

claims.text: Zaroxolyn-type metolazone and Mykrox are not interchangeable.
claims.quote: NOT BE INTERCHANGED FOR ONE ANOTHER.
